checks.topic: Unary tagged finite box and ordered denominator inverse
checks.reason: Both inverse compositions retain the shell, tag, exponents, D, u, and ordering; the exterior transpose and middle exchange are explicit.

Counts are derived from retained indexed solution sets; no inverse from a scalar count is claimed. Exact truth fibres, union multiplicities, intersection diagonals, full lifts, and middle-invariance restriction are present.

checks.topic: Partial domains and variable divisor positivity
checks.reason: Reconstructed-coordinate predicates are evaluated on the passing domain; variable divisors must remain positive on the retained admissible domain. Off-hit zero divisors are not authorized by the construction.

checks.topic: Canonical auxiliaries and vector CRT fibres
checks.reason: Signs, inactive slacks, quotients and remainders have unique bounded extensions. Full lattice kernels and interval lift parameters are retained even when coordinate reduction is not injective.
The full rectangle, prime p, shell range, both tags, finite coprimality predicate, and denominator bounds survive. A<=2 is optional.

findings.kind: missing concrete typed composition after a substantive distinction
findings.description: The distinction between prescribed integer output classes and prime divisors of a chosen cyclotomic input is printed without the exact surviving input/output incidence or a computed selected-factor obstruction. A generic additional-predicate reference does not instantiate that correspondence.
findings.strongest_missing_map: Incidence {(X,q): X lies in the complete positive/bounded input CRT class, q is prime, q divides X^4-X^2+1, q lies in the computed output CRT class}; input fibres are tested prime divisors, output fibres are disjoint noncoprime CRT lifts indexed by the roots of X^4-X^2+1 modulo q.
findings.inverse_fibres: For each q and compatible root rho, M_q=lcm(M,q), b_rho=a+M*rem_(q/g)((M/g)^(-1)*(rho-a)/g), g=gcd(M,q). Every bounded input is b_rho+M_q*t with exact ceil/floor bounds; inverse rho=rem_q(X), t=(X-b_rho)/M_q.
findings.positive_return: Append D_q=(Omega+q*Theta)/K0 and (a_q,y_q,z_q)=(A*B*D_q,q^epsilon*A*C*D_q,q*B*C*D_q). This is a graph bijection; all coordinates are positive integers and the ES identity follows from the retained seed numerator. Additional shell inequalities remain additional retained predicates.

computed_obstruction.interpretation: The selected prime 73 fails the prescribed output class despite compatible CRT classes. This does not prove all prime divisors fail.
